overview: This group of files collectively provides a comprehensive code scanning application that scans files and directories for security vulnerabilities, interacts with Git repositories, and generates reports on detection results. The application utilizes a set of predefined rules for detecting infrastructure-related issues, personally identifiable information (PII), and secrets in code, while also providing a flexible base class for custom rule extensions.

files.purpose: Main entry point for the code scanner application.

functions.name: main
functions.description: Executes the main functionality of the code scanner and returns an integer result.

files.purpose: A module for scanning files and directories for security vulnerabilities.

functions.name: scan_file_content
functions.description: Scans the content of a file for security vulnerabilities.

functions.name: scan_file
functions.description: Scans a file for security vulnerabilities using a provided content reader or default behavior.

functions.name: scan_directory
functions.description: Scans a directory and its contents for security vulnerabilities.

functions.name: scan_files_list
functions.description: Scans a list of files for security vulnerabilities.

files.purpose: Provides functionality for interacting with Git repositories.

functions.name: get_repo_root
functions.description: Returns the root directory of a Git repository.

functions.name: get_staged_files
functions.description: Returns a list of staged files in the repository, optionally filtered by path.

functions.name: get_diff_files
functions.description: Returns a list of files showing differences between branches in the repository, optionally filtered by path.

functions.name: read_staged_content
functions.description: Reads and returns the content of a staged file.

files.purpose: Provides data models for code scanning

classes.name: Severity
classes.description: Represents the severity level of a finding

classes.name: Finding
classes.description: Represents a single finding in a code scan

classes.name: ScanResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a code scan

files.purpose: This module provides a reporter class for generating and saving reports from code scanning results.

classes.name: Reporter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and saving reports from code scanning results.

files.purpose: Provides a base class for detection rules.
This module defines rules for file types.

functions.name: get_file_type
functions.description: Returns the file type based on the given filename.

functions.name: is_supported_file_type
functions.description: Checks if a file type is supported by the application.

files.purpose: Provides infrastructure-related rules for code scanning.

functions.name: load_infra_rules
functions.description: Loads infrastructure-related rules from a configuration file.

functions.name: get_infra_rule
functions.description: Returns an infrastructure rule by its ID.

functions.name: validate_infra_resource
functions.description: Validates an infrastructure resource against the loaded rules.

classes.name: InfraRule
classes.description: Represents an infrastructure-related rule with its ID and validation logic.

files.purpose: This module contains rules for detecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in code.

functions.name: get_pii_keywords
functions.description: Returns a set of keywords to detect PII in code.

functions.name: detect_pii
functions.description: Detects PII in the given code snippet using the provided keywords.

files.purpose: This module contains rules for detecting secrets in code.

functions.name: find_secrets
functions.description: Detects and returns a list of potential secret values in the code.

functions.name: is_secret
functions.description: Checks if a given value is a potential secret.
